vision.name: King Kai
vision.text:
(At the end of your Planning Step, if you control no Allies, search your Life Deck for an Ally named "Bubbles" or "Gregory" and play it.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Choose a Bubbles or Gregory Ally in play. That Ally can make actions regardless of your MP's power stage this combat. Raise your anger 1 level.
POWER: Draw a card. Discard a card from your hand.
vision.note: full-art promo (Japanese name art) of S08 S45; stats and text compared on the sheet, identical to the booster card
